ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 60% of visible surface contains low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and lower regions, with 40% high-intensity white pixels featuring dense black patterns on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region displays a contiguous solid black mass extending from the peduncle. Lateral lobes show a white base-layer with high-density, non-contiguous black mottling, vertical streaks, and irregular geometric blobs concentrated towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 25 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 8-10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile with frequent low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys of 2-5 pixels) across the entire trailing boundary, with more pronounced indentations in the medial-to-lateral transition zones.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature sweeping upwards toward the distal tips; leading edge displays a convex trajectory tapering to sharp points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white calcified protrusions) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and extending along the peripheral edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive presence of unaligned, vertical and diagonal black linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the high-intensity white background on both lateral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of calcified barnacle colonies at distal tips; multiple parallel linear scars (rake marks) suggesting inter- or intra-species interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of barnacle colonization creates a unique, high-contrast white-on-black 'fringe' effect specifically on the outermost edges of the fluke lobes.
